title: GET {oauth.authorization_endpoint} query (member portal page, browser redirect)
description: The store's "Sign in from Customer Portal" and "Verify with WhatsApp" buttons send the shopper here (the heartbeat's oauth.authorization_endpoint, on the member portal host). The member signs in to the portal if needed (inverse OTP or OTP), confirms, and is sent back to redirect_uri with code and state (oauth-callback.query.json). OAuth 2.1: PKCE with S256 only, state required, redirect_uri must match the client's exactly. All values arrive as strings.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes; the store asks for profile and store:link.
